messages.subject: Bayesian Item response modeling
parts:
Hi, Phil... 

Do you think is it possible to do Bayesian IRT analysis using mirt package? I would like to do some Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) resampling, and I hate WinBUGS or OpenBUGS... I found some packages (MLIRT 2.0, CIRT 2.5, see http://www.jean-paulfox.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=category&layout=blog&id=7&Itemid=5) but they did not work for me.

Thanks a lot,

Danilo Assis Pereira, Ph.D.
Brasilia, Brazil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Bayesian Item response modeling
parts:
Hi Danilo,

No, mirt is primarily a MML estimation package, so this is largely outside its scope. I may add Bayesian estimation methods sometime in the future, but certainly not any time soon. Cheers.

Phil
